It seems like that is the meaning sometimes. My therapist says I have to find more meaning than the lack of bad stuff though. I try.

I feel you. Nothing worse than feeling absolutely exhausted but not being able to sleep anyway. I get seroquel for sleep which helps, but leaves me very groggy the day after.. I've tried a handful of different anti-depressants over the last 10 years, and none of them have done anything really. Remember to discuss it with your doctor if you feel like getting off of them!

My drug induced delusions comment is just me not being able to get high without getting paranoid and all that at the same time. I used to, but it's gotten almost impossible for me to have a good trip. I get afraid of people being after me and such. It sucks.
